newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hongkong Telecom shrs soar on China hopes.
newsitem.headline: Hongkong Telecom shrs soar on China hopes.

text.p: Shares in Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd surged on Monday on hopes it might strike lucrative mainland deals thanks to its new shareholder, China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd, analysts said.
The shares were up HK$0.45 at HK$17.60 in late morning.
"It's just continued speculation," said Lloyd Fischer, head of regional telecommunications research with BZW Asia.
"It's the same story -- that China Everbright may buy more and take over the company," said an analyst with a Japanese institution, who declined to be named.
Analysts said the share price was defying gravity.

China Everbright, which is controlled by China's State Council, last month bought 7.74 percent of Hongkong Telecom at HK$12.60 a share. It is borrowing US$1.05 billion to fund up to 70 percent of its purchase. The purchase deadline is June 3.
Fischer said Hongkong Telecom's share price suggested the market valued potential mainland deals it hoped would result from the new relationship at somewhere around US$7 billion.
"It would take a lot of awfully good deals in China to bring that kind of net present value to the company," Fischer said.
Brokers also said rumours that warrants would be issued on Hongkong Telecom might be underpinning its firmness.
